widths.note: both unnamed alleys in blocks 5 and 6 (the E-W one and the N-S one) are 10'

bends.note: Harrison curves: about 26 deg below east at Koebel, about 50 deg near Patterson
Harrison turns from SE (about 50 deg) to ESE (about 14 deg) just east of Patterson and runs ESE to Colerain
Colerain turns here from NW-SE (north part, toward the canal) to due north-south (south part, Harrison/Central to Bank); corner points are the bank building (2400,1467) and the 2206 block (2834,1482)
Central curves gently: about 8 deg below east at Colerain, about 14 deg at Kindel, about 16 deg at Freeman

notes: Brighton corner: Harrison Av. comes in from the west and Central Av. leaves to the ESE; they meet Colerain Av. at the same point (2652,2065), recorded as two T entries (Harrison ends at Colerain, Central starts there). Colerain's north part (NW-SE, about 35 deg off vertical) enters the open plaza north of that point between the bank building and the 2206 Central Av. block, and joins the south part at the bend (2652,1549); north of the plaza the street is bounded on the NE only by a fence line along the canal. The north side of Central east of Colerain is chamfered (2206-2192 fronts) so the plaza is wide; the Central centreline uses the south line minus 30 ft there. Brighton (printed 'BRIGHTON' only, 10 ft) runs from Patterson to Colerain; it is the unnamed '?' alley leaving Patterson on sheet 224. An unnamed 10 ft alley ('?') carries Brighton's line east of Colerain to Kindel (so Colerain/Brighton is a cross), continues east of Kindel (printed 'ALLEY') to Freeman; a second unnamed 10 ft alley ('?') runs from it south to Bank at x~3352 (the '?'/'?' T at (3350,2963) is this N-S alley meeting the E-W alley). Bogen Alley runs from the E-W alley south to Bank. Koebel/Harrison is in the sheet-224 overlap at the left edge (Koebel lines drawn, 40 ft between x~284 and ~539). Freeman north of McMicken (top right) is a separate stub; Freeman does not cross the canal. Harrison's NE side west of Patterson (1136-1128) has buildings, so Koebel and Patterson are T junctions. Bank Street jogs ~18 px at Freeman (east part slightly lower); point is the midpoint. Freeman leans slightly (centre 5606 at Central, 5500 at Bank). Canal, foot bridge and tow path ignored.
